items.title: Inventory and freeze the root Markdown cleanup scope
items.context: Confirm current root Markdown inventory and classify allowed root files versus cleanup candidates using root-markdown-migration-execution-solution.md. This item is complete only when the implementation scope excludes jek.md and the standard root entrypoints.
items.userSees: User sees the cleanup scope list: five allowed root Markdown files stay, and twelve legacy root Markdown files are cleanup candidates.

happy.desc: The root Markdown inventory is explicitly classified into allowed files and cleanup candidates before DEV changes begin.

edge.desc: jek.md and the four standard root entrypoints are excluded from archive/delete operations.

adversarial.desc: The cleanup candidate list is explicit rather than a broad wildcard that could catch user-owned or entrypoint files.

items.title: Remove non-allowed root Markdown files from the root
items.context: Move or archive agent-generated legacy root Markdown files outside the final allowed set. Preserve historical material under docs/koala/legacy/root-markdown when needed, and do not leave KOALA.md or Lattice*.md stubs at repository root.
items.userSees: User sees root KOALA.md, koala-project-overview.md, and root Lattice*.md files gone, with their historical content preserved under docs/koala/legacy/root-markdown/.

happy.desc: All non-allowed root Markdown cleanup candidates are removed from repository root and preserved in docs/koala/legacy/root-markdown/.

edge.desc: No permanent root compatibility stub remains for KOALA.md, koala-project-overview.md, or root Lattice*.md files.

adversarial.desc: The allowed root Markdown files README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md, and jek.md remain at root.

items.title: Update internal references away from removed root Markdown paths
items.context: Update references that point readers or checks at root KOALA.md, koala-project-overview.md, or root Lattice*.md files. References in migration-history docs may intentionally point to archive locations or describe old root filenames as retired.
items.userSees: User sees internal documentation no longer pointing readers at removed root legacy Markdown paths; active references point to canonical docs or historical archive paths.

happy.desc: Reader-facing references to removed root docs are updated to canonical decision docs or archive paths.

edge.desc: Code and tests may still mention KOALA.md only as legacy compatibility asset behavior, not as a required root document.

adversarial.desc: Reference updates do not add new Production Safety, authority, capability, or unattended-readiness claims.

items.title: Verify final root inventory and migration safety gates
items.context: Run inventory, reference scans, no-overclaim scans, validate, and convergence checks. The root Markdown inventory must match README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md, and jek.md only.
items.userSees: User sees validation PASS and root Markdown inventory exactly AGENTS.md, CHANGELOG.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md, and jek.md.

happy.desc: Final root Markdown inventory exactly matches the approved five-file root set.

edge.desc: Reference and no-overclaim scans are reviewed after cleanup and any remaining legacy mentions are intentional archive or compatibility references.

adversarial.desc: Lattice validate and convergence checks pass after moving/deleting the root legacy docs.
